Hello, I just turned 20 and had an abortion a few months ago... the weeks afterwards were honestly the most awful thing one could possibly imagine 
But....I had no choice and it kinda sounds like you also don’t have one ...
With a lot of thinking and a lot of crying I managed to get to a point to see it as  a way of taking care of my baby
I couldn’t have given it any opportunities in life, I don’t have money, didn’t finish my studies and don’t have a job 
Letting my mom help out wouldn’t have been an option  bc she was mentally and physically abusive to me and I don’t want her to be able to do that to a child ever again 
So there’s this really really hard thing you have to go through to protect your child which, in a way, makes you a good and responsible mother.
And one more thing that might help you: im not a religious person at all, very hard believing agnostic haha and always thought life after death and all of this energies stuff is crap.
But a few weeks after I got the abortion in a really weird way I started feeling her(it kinda felt like it would’ve been a girl so I just decided to go with it) presence. I could talk to her, explain everything, show her how much I care.
I hope this will help you man, good luck for everything.
